purpose: Retrospective macro-market calendar anchors only. These anchors are not universal per-series shock onset claims or proof of causal impact.

matching_rules.detection_timestamp: Use the actual detector availability timestamp derived from detection_time; never use estimated_onset for real-time lead claims.
matching_rules.lead_sign: warning_lead_months > 0 means detector signal predates anchor; negative means post-anchor lag.
matching_rules.matching: Greedy minimum-absolute-calendar-distance one-to-one matching per series and mode; an alarm cannot match more than one anchor and an anchor cannot reuse an alarm.
matching_rules.seismic: Macro shock anchors are not matched to seismic belts. Seismic event-time series are evaluated separately.
matching_rules.causality: A temporal match does not establish causation or series-specific physical impact.

events.label: Lehman Brothers bankruptcy / global financial-crisis calendar anchor
events.interpretation: Historical calendar anchor; commodity-specific impacts and turning points may differ.

events.label: 2014 crude-oil price decline calendar anchor
events.interpretation: Start-of-decline calendar reference for the international oil-price episode; not assumed to be the impact date for every energy series.

events.label: WHO characterization of COVID-19 as a pandemic
events.interpretation: Official global calendar anchor; country and commodity effects were staggered and may predate or postdate this date.

events.label: Beginning of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine / commodity-supply shock anchor
events.domain_scope: energy, metals, agriculture and food commodities
events.interpretation: Calendar anchor for the geopolitical supply shock; not causal attribution to any particular series.
